lessons.title: 27.1 Structural biology
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain structural biology and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Structural biology studies the three-dimensional forms of biomolecules and relates molecular shape to biological activity.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: ساختی حیاتیات حیاتی سالمات کی سہ جہتی ساخت کا مطالعہ کرتی ہے اور سالماتی شکل کو حیاتیاتی عمل سے جوڑتی ہے۔
explanations.sd: ساختي حياتيات حياتياتي ماليڪيولن جي ٽي-رخا بناوت جو مطالعو ڪري ٿي ۽ ماليڪيولي شڪل کي حياتياتي ڪم سان ڳنڍي ٿي.

lessons.title: 27.2 X-ray crystallography
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain x-ray crystallography and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

X-ray crystallography uses diffraction patterns from crystals to infer atomic arrangements in ordered biomolecular structures.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

lessons.title: 27.3 Other structure methods
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain other structure methods and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

NMR spectroscopy and cryo-electron microscopy provide complementary information about molecular structure, dynamics and large complexes.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: NMR اسپیکٹروسکوپی اور کرائیو الیکٹران مائیکروسکوپی سالماتی ساخت، حرکت اور بڑے کمپلیکس کے بارے میں تکمیلی معلومات دیتی ہیں۔

lessons.title: 27.4 Computational biology and databases
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain computational biology and databases and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Computational biology uses algorithms and computing to analyse biological data; public databases store sequences and molecular structures.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: کمپیوٹیشنل بائیولوجی حیاتیاتی ڈیٹا کے تجزیے کے لیے الگورتھم اور کمپیوٹر استعمال کرتی ہے؛ عوامی ڈیٹابیس ترتیبیں اور سالماتی ساخت محفوظ کرتے ہیں۔

lessons.title: 27.5 Homology and applications
lessons.content:
## Learning outcomes
Explain homology and applications and connect the concept with evidence, biological function and a relevant application.

Sequence or structural homology suggests shared ancestry; computational comparisons support research in evolution, agriculture and disease biology.

**Study task:** Define the key terms, explain the sequence or mechanism, and interpret a suitable diagram, table or real-world example.

explanations.ur: ترتیبی یا ساختی ہومولوجی مشترک نسب کی طرف اشارہ کرتی ہے؛ کمپیوٹیشنل موازنہ ارتقا، زراعت اور بیماریوں کی تحقیق میں مدد دیتا ہے۔

options.A: Structural biology studies the three-dimensional forms of biomolecules and relates molecular shape to biological activity.
options.B: X-ray crystallography uses diffraction patterns from crystals to infer atomic arrangements in ordered biomolecular structures.
options.C: NMR spectroscopy and cryo-electron microscopy provide complementary information about molecular structure, dynamics and large complexes.
options.D: Computational biology uses algorithms and computing to analyse biological data; public databases store sequences and molecular structures.
